record.content: Reviewed National Digital Trails features place evidenced route endpoints at the Parker Lake, McGee Creek, Tamarack Lakes, Mosquito Flat, North Lake, Sabrina Basin, South Lake, Yost/Fern, Upper Rock Creek/East Fork, and Lundy Canyon access identities. The Lundy endpoint is independently corroborated by a named OpenStreetMap trailhead point approximately ten meters away.
